newsitem.title: UK: UK EU-harmonised CPI +2.0% y/y in February.
newsitem.headline: UK EU-harmonised CPI +2.0% y/y in February.

text.p: Britain's new measure of consumer price inflation, harmonised with European Union nations, showed consumer prices rose 2.0 percent in the 12 months to February, the Office for National Statistics said on Thursday.

Revised figures for January, the first month for which this figure was published, the harmonised consumer price indicator showed inflation running at 2.1 percent. It was originally quoted at 2.2 percent.
The ONS said the new measure is for EU-comparative purposes and does not replace the UK retail price index.
